data.name: aMAZE Lunar
data.detailed_description:
aMAZE Lunar is a colorful 2D maze puzzle game that combines classic labyrinth challenges with Lunar New Year-inspired visuals, traditional Asian art, and relaxing gameplay. Guide a lucky Chinese coin through winding pathways, collect pieces of a Chinese dragon, and activate magical portals in this charming collection of logic puzzles and brain teasers.

Explore a vibrant world of Asian-inspired labyrinths where every turn brings a new challenge. Navigate branching paths, avoid dead ends, and carefully explore each maze to collect all the dragon pieces needed to activate the exit portal. Use your logic, concentration, and spatial reasoning to discover the correct route and complete each puzzle.

With 50 levels and six different types of labyrinths, aMAZE Lunar offers a variety of maze-solving challenges that gradually become larger and more complex. Each level tests your problem-solving skills, patience, and attention to detail while rewarding careful exploration and logical thinking.

Inspired by the colorful traditions and symbolic imagery of Lunar New Year and Chinese culture, the game combines familiar maze mechanics with decorative dragon motifs and lucky coin imagery. Its distinctive visual style adds a festive atmosphere to the classic puzzle-solving experience.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, relaxing brain teasers, challenging maze adventures, or Lunar New Year-themed games, aMAZE Lunar offers an accessible and rewarding experience for players of different skill levels. Discover intricate labyrinth layouts, collect dragon pieces, unlock portals, and enjoy the satisfaction of finding your way through every maze.

With its charming Asian-inspired 2D visuals, peaceful background music, and intuitive controls, aMAZE Lunar delivers a relaxing yet engaging single-player puzzle experience. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, casual gamers, and anyone who appreciates colorful logic games with a festive cultural theme.

Key Features

  • 50 challenging levels – Explore increasingly intricate labyrinths that test your logic, concentration, and navigation skills.

  • 6 types of labyrinths – Discover different maze designs with varied layouts and pathfinding challenges.

  • Lucky Chinese coin gameplay – Guide a traditional Chinese lucky coin through winding passages and reach the activated portal.

  • Chinese dragon collection puzzles – Collect all the dragon pieces scattered throughout each maze to unlock the exit portal.

  • Portal-based maze challenges – Explore the labyrinth, gather the required pieces, and find your way to the destination.

  • Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your concentration, patience, spatial reasoning, and problem-solving skills.

  • Lunar New Year-inspired art – Enjoy colorful 2D visuals featuring traditional Asian aesthetics, Chinese dragon imagery, and festive motifs.

  • Relaxing background music – Solve labyrinths at your own pace with a calm and peaceful soundtrack.

  • Increasing difficulty – Face larger and more complex mazes as you progress through the game.

  • Simple, intuitive controls – Navigate the labyrinths using WASD or the arrow keys.

  • 100 Steam Achievements – Complete challenges and unlock achievements throughout your journey.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your game progress synchronized across supported devices.

  • Family-friendly puzzle experience – Accessible gameplay for casual players and labyrinth enthusiasts alike.

Collect the dragon pieces, unlock the portals, and discover your path through every Lunar New Year-inspired labyrinth!
